title: Kobalos Linux Backdoor Investigation
description: Investigate a Kobalos Linux backdoor malware infection on a target host.
prerequisites: Familiarity with SSH and network traffic analysis
outcomes: Identify the running service associated with Kobalos
Locate the persistence mechanism used by Kobalos

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content:
Welcome to the Kobalos Linux Backdoor Investigation scenario. Your goal is to investigate a Kobalos infection on a target host and identify its behavior.

This scenario will guide you through tasks that help you understand how Kobalos operates and how to detect it in your environment.

levels.title: Access the Target Host
levels.cloud_content: Connect to the target host using SSH with the provided credentials.
levels.local_content: Access the local sandbox environment and navigate to the target host.

levels.title: Identify Running Service
levels.content: List running services on the target host and identify the service associated with Kobalos.
levels.solution: Use `ss -al` or `netstat -tuln` to list active connections and find the service associated with Kobalos (e.g., sshd).

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Check for unusual processes related to SSH.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Look for connections on the expected C2 port (7070).

levels.title: Locate Persistence Mechanism
levels.content: Investigate the target host for signs of Kobalos persistence.
levels.solution: Examine system files, configurations, and running processes to find indicators of Kobalos' persistence (e.g., modified sshd configuration or standalone executables).

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Check the sshd configuration file for unusual settings.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Look for standalone executables related to Kobalos.

levels.title: Detect Data Exfiltration
levels.content: Analyze logs, network traffic, and system files to find indicators of stolen SSH credentials being sent over the network.
levels.solution: Inspect system logs for unusual SSH activity, analyze network traffic for non-SSH traffic on the port attributed to an SSH server, and search for known indicators of compromise in logs and system files.

hints.title: Hint 1
hints.content: Check the SSH log file for unusual activity.

hints.title: Hint 2
hints.content: Investigate network traffic for non-SSH traffic on the port attributed to an SSH server.
